The [[Candy Corn Tyrant]] is an enormous creature sent to the [[Ascalon Settlement]] by [[Mad King Thorn]].

== Locations ==
*[[Kryta]]
**{{NPC location|North Kryta Province}} (only during [[Evil Residents]] or [[Evil Residents Code: Harmonica]])

== Skills ==
14...16 [[Strength]]
*{{Skill icon|Earth Shaker}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Mighty Blow}}
*{{skill icon|Mokele Smash}}
*{{skill icon|Overbearing Smash}}
*{{skill icon|Thrill of Victory}}
*{{skill icon|Tiger Stance}}
*{{skill icon|Mending Touch}}

== Notes ==
*It is larger than other Candy Corn creatures, such as [[Mad King's Guard]].

== Trivia ==
*The quests it appears in (Evil Residents and Evil Residents Code: Harmonica) are references to the [[w:Resident Evil|Resident Evil]] video game series, in which Tyrants are featured as boss enemies.
